title: Gate artist public profile by visibility selector
goal: Make the artist profile visibility selector actually gate the public profile so hidden artists are not discoverable, per SIM-20260922-ARTIST-001.

in: Map the visibility selector state to the settings/public_profile flag and read paths
Deny public access to hidden artist profiles across artist routes and search
Add client and API tests for visible versus hidden profiles
out: Public surfacing of hidden artist profiles

acceptance_criteria: SIM-20260922-ARTIST-001 reruns and passes in the artist simulation slice with receiving-side evidence

progress.summary: Wave 34 (DB-008 code-drift cluster 'artist') plus the ARTIST-005 visibility gate. Repointed every artist-owned consumer of a relation/column the active chain never creates: public artist and band galleries now read the canonical EPK document (artist_epk_settings.settings.photoItems) instead of artist_photos/artist_videos; public and dashboard stats are derived from in-chain rows instead of the get_enhanced_artist_stats RPC; merchandise reads/writes marketplace_listings through the mapping the marketplace backfill route already records; artist profile creation calls create_artist_account instead of ensure_artist_profile; artist event crew is staff_members linked by event_participants with a new server-side assertEventScope ownership check; the event detail page reads logistics_tasks.status, artist_financial_transactions.type/occurred_at (scoped by user_id + source_id), venue_profiles and booking_requests without venue_id; the event wizard writes poster_url/start_at/end_time/venue_name/ticket_price_min/event_type and merges social links + ticket types into producer_settings. Three files with zero verified importers were deleted (app/artist/events/actions/marketing.ts, app/artist/events/actions/analytics.ts, app/artist/features/analytics/analytics-dashboard.tsx). The ARTIST-005 visibility gate itself is unchanged and still enforced. Acceptance is still NOT claimed: SIM-20260922-ARTIST-001 needs a hosted rerun and no staging target exists.
completed: lib/artist/profile-visibility.ts: pure mapping helpers (privacy selector <-> settings.public_profile boolean; missing flag defaults public).
contexts/artist-context.tsx updateDetailedProfile writes settings.public_profile from the selector on every save.
app/artist/profile/page.tsx buildFormFromProfile round-trips the canonical flag into the selector (settings.public_profile === false -> Private).
app/api/artist/[artistName]/route.ts: data-boundary gate denies non-owners of hidden profiles (404), keeping the public-by-name API in sync with the DTO gate.
No visibility defaults changed; verified maps to public (read-side verified-only enforcement does not exist and is recorded in DECISIONS.md DOMAIN-002).

checkpoints.summary: ARTIST-005 implemented (uncommitted, base SHA d2176904). The visibility selector now maps to settings.public_profile via lib/artist/profile-visibility.ts: contexts/artist-context.tsx writes public_profile: privacySettingsToPublicProfileFlag(profileData.privacy_settings); app/artist/profile/page.tsx round-trips the canonical flag into the selector; app/api/artist/[artistName]/route.ts gates hidden profiles to owners at the data boundary. The existing read gates (getPublicArtistProfileDTO null for non-owners, enhanced/account search settings.public_profile !== false, owner-only preview banner in public-artist-page.tsx) were already boolean-honoring and required no change. Verified maps to public (no read-side enforcement). Focused vitest: __tests__/artist/ 14 files / 71 tests passed (12 new), parity suite 11/11; eslint 0 errors (1 pre-existing warning in contexts/artist-context.tsx:654). Recorded durable fact in STATE.md and decision DOMAIN-002 in DECISIONS.md.
